snippet.title: Stupid Never Dies | Release Date Announcement
snippet.description:
Launching October 21, 2026! 🎉
*(October 22 in select regions. Please check your local digital storefront for details.)

The launch date for Stupid Never Dies, GPTRACK50’s all-new Blazing Fast Growth Action RPG, has officially been announced!

Bite, Rip, Rise!!
Watch the weakest zombie become ridiculously powerful and experience the ultimate underdog action RPG!

Wishlist the game today! 

🎮 Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3486530/

🎮 PlayStation Store
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10013888


Title Name : Stupid Never Dies 
Release Date : October 21st, 2026 (22nd in select regions)
Genre : Blazing Fast Growth 3D Action RPG 
Player# : Single play 
Platforms : PS5, PC (Steam) 
ESRB: M
